name: Additional public incidents - pending source review v2
notice: Six retrospective cases paraphrased from five first-party reports. Labels, risks, scopes and prerequisites are assistant judgments, pending independent review. All cases from one source report share a split. Not a frozen pooled calibration cohort or a confirmatory holdout. Source articles retain their original rights.

records.label: rollback_config
records.evidence: Maintenance disrupts GitHub's live-update service. Reconnecting clients overload web servers and cause widespread request failures.
records.locator: December 17 section; maintenance rollback and scaling paragraph
records.reported_recovery: Reversed maintenance changes and expanded service capacity.
records.scope_note: The report gives inconsistent start times but agrees on the date. Rollback is only the coarse label; both recovery actions are retained. No dependency is established.

records.label: restart_service
records.evidence: Expired internal credentials prevent marketing subscription changes; a related failure later affects resource forms. Expiry alerts did not fire correctly.
records.locator: March 29 7:00 UTC section; renewal and redeployment paragraph
records.scope_note: One combined case covers the related March 29 and March 31 failures. Restart is a coarse mapping of redeployment, not credential renewal. Renewal before redeployment is an inferred prerequisite requiring review.

steps.description: Redeploy services using the renewed credentials.

records.label: rollback_config
records.evidence: Codespaces creation and startup fail following manual configuration edits to an internal dependency.
records.scope_note: Only immediate recovery is modeled; future rollout safeguards are excluded.

steps.description: Revert the internal dependency configuration changes.

records.label: rollback_config
records.evidence: Issue attachments fail with CORS errors after a client feature adds a request header.

records.label: scale_capacity
records.evidence: Public Ubuntu-24 Actions jobs queue after failover leaves backend caching misconfigured and jobs assigned twice.
records.reported_recovery: Fixed caching and expanded runner pools.
records.scope_note: Scaling alone is incomplete. No strict dependency is stated.

steps.description: Expand runner pools to clear queued jobs.

records.label: scale_capacity
records.evidence: Enterprise migrations stop after an infrastructure component is removed from service and cannot be restored to its earlier configuration.
records.scope_note: Capacity is a coarse mapping of replacement provisioning, not ordinary horizontal scaling. Customer allow-list changes are conditional follow-up, excluded from this operator-recovery reference.
